breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification only describes the high-symmetry k-path for the bands calculation step and does not address the conflicting k-point sampling instructions (gamma-centered vs. half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack). The ground truth resolves this by retaining only the gamma-centered k-point grid instruction and removing the half-shift Monkhorst-Pack reference. The generated text neither confirms the gamma-centered grid for SCF/NSCF nor explicitly removes the erroneous half-shift instruction, so the inconsistency is not resolved.
